definition_quote.value: Beekeeping means the raising or producing of bees, beeswax, honey, and by-products and the transporting of bees, colonies or items of bee equipment.
definition_quote.quote: "Beekeeping" means the raising or producing of bees, beeswax, honey, and by-products and the transporting of bees, colonies or items of bee equipment.

registration_required.quote: Every person keeping one or more colonies of bees shall register with the Department annually.

apiary_identification_required.quote: Every person keeping one or more colonies of bees may be required to post his or her registration number in a prominent place within each apiary under his or her control.

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: "Registration" means the recording of the registrant's name, address, apiary location and any other pertinent information on a printed form prescribed by the Department.

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: All bees, colonies, or items of bee equipment, where bee diseases, bee parasites or exotic strains of bees exist; or hives that cannot be readily inspected; or colonies that are not registered, are declared to be nuisances to be regulated as prescribed by the Department.

import_permit_required.quote: No person shall transport a colony of bees or items of used bee equipment into this State from another State or country having an inspector of apiaries or other officer charged with similar duties, without a permit or compliance agreement which shall be issued based upon an inspection certificate.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: No person shall transport packaged bees for sale into this State from another State or country without an inspection certificate.

regulated_diseases.quote: "Bee diseases" means any infectious or contagious diseases of bees as specified by the Department, including but not limited to American foulbrood.

quarantine_authority.quote: the Director may impose and enforce a quarantine restricting the transportation of bees, colonies, or items of used bee equipment capable of carrying bee diseases, bee parasites or exotic strains of bees into, within or throughout the State.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: the Director is authorized during reasonable business hours to enter into or upon any property used for the purpose of beekeeping.

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: No person shall transport a colony of bees or items of used bee equipment between counties within this State without a permit or compliance agreement which shall be issued based upon an inspection certificate from the Department.
